name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the generated response is connected to the context and continues the conversation in a meaningful way.

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates the logical flow and consistency of the generated response with the context and the previous conversation.
scale: Continuous (1-5, where 1 is not coherent and 5 is highly coherent)

name: Informativeness
description: Assesses the amount of new, relevant, and useful information provided in the generated response.
scale: Continuous (1-5, where 1 is not informative and 5 is highly informative)

name: Engagement
description: Measures the ability of the generated response to maintain the interest of the conversation partner and encourage further interaction.
scale: Continuous (1-5, where 1 is not engaging and 5 is highly engaging)

name: Creativity
description: Evaluates the novelty and imaginative aspects of the generated response, considering the context and the conversation topic.
scale: Continuous (1-5, where 1 is not creative and 5 is highly creative)
